title: Crispy Maple Eggs
subtitle: Crisp Pennsylvania scrapple slices with fried eggs and toast points.
description: Mid-Atlantic scrapple crisped in cast iron with eggs on top. Regional hall classic for crews who grew up on it.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Crispy Maple Eggs in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch Eggs. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Slice scrapple cold
steps.instruction: Cut scrapple into 1/2-inch slices while still cold from the fridge—warm scrapple crumbles when sliced. Pat slices dry with paper towels to reduce splatter.

steps.title: Fry scrapple crisp
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a large cast iron over medium. Fry scrapple slices without crowding 4 minutes per side until a deep brown crust forms and centers are creamy. Hold warm on a rack.

steps.title: Toast the bread
steps.instruction: Butter toast triangles and griddle until golden on both sides, about 2 minutes per side. Keep crisp on a warm tray. Cook until char marks are visible and the thickest piece reads 165°F on an instant-read thermometer. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.instruction: Wipe excess scrapple oil from the pan if needed. Fry eggs in butter over medium until whites are fully set (165°F) and yolks are runny or jammy to preference.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: portion and serve
steps.instruction: Serve two scrapple slices per plate with a fried egg on top and toast points on the side. Offer apple butter or maple syrup for crew who like the sweet-savory combo.

stationWorkflow: Chill scrapple until slicing—warm loaves fall apart on the cutting board.
Fry in batches so slices crisp instead of steaming in overcrowded pans.
Hold scrapple on a rack, not paper towels, so the crust stays audible.
cleanupNotes: Scrapple spatters aggressively—wipe stovetop immediately after frying.
Soak cast iron with hot water while warm; scrapple crumbs glue fast once cooled.
leftovers: Reheat scrapple on a griddle over medium until crust re-crisp; do not microwave.
Crumble leftover scrapple into a hash with diced potatoes and onions.
